_comment: HCM install policy. This is an HCM convention, NOT a Claude Code feature.
Claude Code marketplaces cannot auto-install: adding a marketplace only registers the
catalog, and defaultEnabled controls whether an installed plugin is on, not whether it
gets installed. Installation is therefore consumer-side - ClaudeDeploy reads this file
It is deliberately NOT a field inside .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. That file is read
live from main by every endpoint, there is no published schema to validate an unknown key
against, and a manifest that fails to parse takes the whole catalog down. HCM policy also
is not a property of the plugin. CI keeps the two files consistent.
autoInstall: installed on every endpoint by ClaudeDeploy, without being asked for.
Everything else in the catalog is available on request via /plugin install <name>@hcm.
Adding a name here pushes that plugin to the whole fleet. Treat it as a deployment, not
